expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx：未证明应用入口以 usePromise: true 安装 API Proxy。

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js:1 imports { request } directly from @mpxjs/api-proxy, and outputs/src/services/search.js:4-6 uses request(...).then for trending keywords. This is the raw named import path, not configured mpx.request or wx.request compiled through the configured API Proxy path.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js / outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想请求未保存直接 RequestTask 或 Promise.__returned 原始任务。

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想回调未同时证明当前任务身份与当前关键词/请求代际。

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:15 imports navigateTo and showToast from @mpxjs/api-proxy. Error prompts use showToast at lines 32-35 and 77-80; product detail navigation uses navigateTo at lines 89-91.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx no longer uses location or alert, and no fetch was found, but outputs/src/services/search.js:1 and outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:15 use raw @mpxjs/api-proxy named imports without any explicit handling or note that these calls do not inherit app-level mpx.use options/custom/Promise configuration. The request named import is also directly used as a Promise at outputs/src/services/search.js:4-6 and outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:69-81.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: The UI paths remain present: trending load at outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:26-36, input search at 43-44, clear handling at 61-63, abort handling at 49-53, result rendering at template lines 7-9, and detail navigation at 88-91. However the core request chain is not complete because outputs/src/services/search.js:4-6 and outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:69-81 treat raw @mpxjs/api-proxy request results as Promises without installing Promise mode in outputs/src/app.mpx.

checks.note: 该文件不是 compile-validate 支持的 page/component 入口；记录完整性门禁，不把它伪报为独立 Mpx 编译。

compile.boundary: 所有声明输出先检查条件编译语义；所有可作为 page/component 入口的 .mpx 均执行真实 Web 编译；app.mpx、HTML 和独立配置仅做完整性门禁，JS 另做语法检查。

suggestions: q3 is narrower than q2: q2 allows Promise.__returned as a valid cancellable-task approach, but q3 requires success/fail callbacks specifically, which could mark an otherwise valid Promise.__returned implementation as failing.

q5 asks candidates using raw @mpxjs/api-proxy named imports to make an explicit non-inheritance statement, but the required output is complete files only and no location or format for that statement is defined.
eval_feedback.overall: The candidate removes location/alert for navigation and toasts and stores an abortable suggestion task, but it misses the required app-level API Proxy installation and incorrectly uses raw @mpxjs/api-proxy request imports as Promises, breaking the main request behavior.
